title: Doctor: what `expectrail doctor --json` found on one machine
description: Written by expectrail.doctor.document and read by expectrail.doctor.problems. It says what a verification needs on this machine and whether each piece is there. It is not a verdict on any change. No value of any key or other secret is in it: the vision key is `present` or `absent`, with the names of the environment variables that are set.

expectrail.description: The version of Expectrail that ran the checks.

ok.description: True exactly when no check that is required has a status other than ok. A reader recomputes it from the checks.

status.description: ok or missing for a piece that was checked; skipped when it could not be tried (what it needs is missing, or this platform is not checked); present or absent for the vision key.

required.description: A required piece that is not ok makes `ok` false and the command exit 3.

found.description: What was found, or what is wrong.

fix.description: What to do about it. Null exactly when the status is ok, present or absent.
